headline: Abhishek Narbaria files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Abhishek Narbaria has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or proposed takeover of TCC Concept Limited.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Reg 31(4) requires that when an acquirer intends to make a public announcement of acquisition, the exchange must be notified in advance. This filing precedes formal public announcement and triggers board approval, valuation and due diligence obligations. The acquirer's identity (Abhishek Narbaria), target (TCC Concept Limited), and timing confirm the announcement phase of a material corporate acquisition.
